sections.text:
Ability Power 140. Damages all enemies 3 times with dark physical piercer damage.
Added effect: Increases critical hit chance of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds and 15% chance to nullify damage taken by all allies for 50 seconds.
Level bonus: Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
